creativeDirectionPilot.design: 5 fresh books (not used in cycles 11–14), the scan's candidates, ONE fresh author with single-relation.md + creative-direction.md choosing ≤ 1 beat per book (paradox-of-choice skipped honestly); A = production scene, B = the contract (isolated configs, GitHub Actions); answer key for all 20 candidates written from the narration only BEFORE the author's choice was known; 2 blind describers (4 strips of 4 different scenes, the two versions of a scene never to the same describer), 2 judge passes

humanStudyV2.behaviour: one video at a time; its questions; answers locked; then the other version; then 'which was better made' + why (required); per-participant seeded scene order and first-version (balanced); anonymous participant id = seed; JSON: studyVersion, anonymousParticipantId, randomizationSeed, scene id, presentation order, separate comprehension answers per video, wrong-inference / uncertainty, visual preference, reason, confidence, completionStatus (incomplete when any required answer is missing); no key / version identity in the package; per-package storage key
humanStudyV2.browserTest: GitHub Actions run 42049342354: Chromium 36 / 36 and Firefox 36 / 36 checks passed (open-source builds cannot decode h264 — real Chrome / Edge / Windows Firefox can; README recommends Chrome / Edge)
